featured_reviews.name: Feriel Palia-Jackson
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely nobody I trust more than the Raj Company for all my furniture! A faithful recreation of a mid century Danish desk (sized up to current European standards), beautiful colonial beds, and a Rick Owens inspired dining table are just a few of the wonderful pieces I’ve got from them over the years. Great furniture is art, and nobody builds to last like them. The perfect combination of all the warmth of a family owned business; but the meticulous craftsmanship and quality control of a major creative company - I defy you to find better anywhere!

featured_reviews.name: Yashasvini Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: As someone who loves colonial style furniture, I have over the years purchased many pieces from Armaan and his team. The quality and attention to detail is of the highest calibre. I treasure each piece I’ve ordered from them.

featured_reviews.name: Neeraj Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited The Raj Company showroom for my house furniture. They have exceptional antique and colonial furniture collection. Staff was incredibly knowledgeable. What sets this place apart is quality. I would 💯% recommend this company, if any one looking to buy furniture. Kudos

featured_reviews.name: shifa rehman
featured_reviews.review_text: If you value quality and detail, The Raj Company is the place to go. Their bespoke approach, beautiful materials, and multiple inlay and finish options make the customisation process enjoyable and stress-free.

featured_reviews.name: Aneetha Devi
featured_reviews.review_text: The Raj Company truly excels at bespoke design. The quality of materials, attention to detail, and range of finishes and inlay options are impressive. The customisation process felt seamless and well thought out, making it easy to create something that felt personal and unique.

featured_reviews.name: Sadhana Padhye
featured_reviews.review_text:
As both an interior designer and an avid collector of antiques, I am very particular about authenticity, proportion, and finish. My recent experience with The Raj Co. was excellent — the salesman understood design sensibilities and guided me toward pieces that aligned beautifully with my project. The final furniture delivered was true to its period style, with craftsmanship and polish that reflect genuine respect for heritage design.

They are offering more customization options — for example, alternative finishes, upholstery choices, or size adaptations while still preserving the antique character.  They even provide detailed drawings and sample pieces if needed to review. The communication and connectivity is really easy when it comes to the follow-ups. This is making their collection even more versatile for designers like me working across different spaces.

Overall, I am impressed with both their service and the artistry of their work, and I look forward to collaborating with them on future projects too.

featured_reviews.name: Keertana Anumandala
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience! The highlight for me was the customisation experience. The raj company offers high quality materials, bespoke design and several options of finishes, materials and inlay options. Perfect for easy customisation.

featured_reviews.name: Ishann Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: What stood out to me most was the level of customisation The Raj Company offers. From materials to finishes and intricate inlay work, everything felt premium and thoughtfully curated. An amazing experience overall. The craftsmanship is top-notch, A great place for anyone looking for high-quality, made-to-order pieces.

name: Janata Stationery & Art Bandra
description:
Established in 1970, Janata Book Centre was started by Late.Khimji Lalji Chheda which specialized in
school and college books along with school and office stationery.
Later in 1988 Mr.Ashok Khimji Chheda s/o Khimji Lalji Chheda joined the family business and introduced
a range of fine art and craft materials.
As the demand for fine art materials increased, slowly we started to focus on the fine art range.
Now we specialise in Fine Art, Architectural, Interior, Jewellery, Fashion Designing Materials, School & Office Stationery. Now the store is also known as “Janata Stationery & Art"
Soon Mr. Chheda inaugurated another store for All types of Papers & Craft Materials known as "Veerat Paper Bazar"

Somewhat hidden away across from the bustling Regal Circle, Avante is easily missed.  We started going there because of their lovely camel bone boxes, which have become a staple present for friends.

featured_reviews.name: Vinesh Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avante Cottage Crafts was an A++++ experience.  Every time I look at the pieces I purchased, I not only remember my trip to Mumbai, but also the great shopping experience the staff provided.

The Pieces: The large selection of high quality pieces made it a one-stop shop for me.  I walked away with pieces that range from classical to modern, enhance any room, and make for great conversation.  I was most impressed with the wood-pressed painting and silk tapestries I purchased for my home.

The Staff: The staff is absolutely dedicated to service and ensuring you'll have a great experience.  They personally select the items they stock, and it shows in the way they help you.  Once the team knew more about my home and the aesthetic I was looking for, they were able to quickly pick out items I would like - explaining the origin, workmanship, and significance of each piece.  They even suggested ways to best display the pieces as an ensemble.

Shipping: Packaging and shipping were also very easy.  I decided not to ship the items so they were hand-delivered to my hotel room - free of charge (although I did tip).  Each piece was wrapped in bubble tape and styrofoam, and individually boxed.  I arrived home with showroom quality pieces and immediately put them on display.

Bottom line: I'll happily return on my next visit, and think you'll have as great an experience as I did.  The store is easy to find near the Regal Cinema; the selection of pieces are amazing; and the helpful staff is even better.

name: Silver Emporium
description:
Built on the foundation of Trust, Legacy, Design, and Handcrafted Excellence, Silver Emporium is a name that reflects India’s timeless relationship with silver.

What began in 1981 with Mr. Kantilal Mehta’s vision in Mumbai has grown into one of India’s largest silver manufacturing houses—backed by 35 years of legacy and craftsmanship. Our journey is shaped by generations of skilled artisans and a deep-rooted understanding of silver as both tradition and expression.

With our state-of-the-art manufacturing unit in Jaipur, we seamlessly blend design with handcrafted precision to create pieces that are not just products, but intricate masterpieces. Every creation reflects attention to detail, thoughtful artistry, and unmatched quality.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Saraogi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a silver artefact that turned out to be defective. When I sent it for repair, it was returned 5% lighter. They tried to sneak it past us, but we had photos of the original weight and re-weighed it right in their shop.

Instead of an apology, the owner was incredibly arrogant. He blamed his karigars and even his own weighing scale—anything to avoid taking responsibility. We don’t care about the marginal silver lost, but the blatant dishonesty and rude behavior are unacceptable. If you shop here, be prepared to go the Kalbadevi police station next.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Poor customer service and surprisingly arrogant attitude.Many shops sell silver and silverware, but the person I interacted with today was anything but customer-friendly. The behaviour was dismissive and completely unsuitable for a client-facing role.
I’ve purchased from this store before, and even visited today intending to buy again, but I walked out midway because of the experience. Won’t be returning. There are plenty of shops in Mumbai where people understand how to speak to customers. I wanted to place order for silver utensils and said I will pay advance and I was trying to understand how much advance but the person on other side just kept on talking as if I didn't want to pay advance. Zero customer friendliness and poor listening skill.
